## Reviewer Checklist
To be completed by the independent reviewer:

- Perform a review of the site using the CloudFlare pages preview URL
- Test all functionality that this code change could impact
    - Ensure grammar and content meets all current guidelines
    - Request changes if needed
    - Approve review if PR template is complete, no issues found, and all build steps have passed without error

Read more about the [Pull Request Review Process](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/reviewing-changes-in-pull-requests/reviewing-proposed-changes-in-a-pull-request)
